screen-subcomparch.technical-specification: A single LiveView process rendering the link list, subscribing to link_admin's own PubSub topic for live updates.
screen-subcomparch.public-surface: Mounts at /links; no function calls beyond LiveView's own callbacks.
screen-subcomparch.private-surface: Internal assigns for the current link set and any pending retire confirmation.

process.name: link_list_live_process
process.purpose: One process per connected owner viewing their link list.
